title: Practice: Steps to zero
description:
Count the steps needed to reduce n to zero. At each step, divide n by 2 if it is even. Otherwise, subtract 1. Stop at zero. Use a function argument, not stdin. Constraint: 0 <= n <= 1000000.

Examples: 0 -> 0; 8 -> 4; 14 -> 6. For 14, the sequence is 14, 7, 6, 3, 2, 1, 0.
reference: int steps_to_zero(int n) { int steps = 0; while (n > 0) { n = n % 2 == 0 ? n / 2 : n - 1; ++steps; } return steps; }
